assessment_summary: Inspected the installation at /opt/qisutu using the supplied guide and summary, then exercised the live system. Verified instance config and lock files, security key and config module, Apache vhost validity and HTTP endpoints, MariaDB schema/version/admin seed data, the REST API, the background daemon process, Perl module dependencies, and system-user/permission setup. A real authenticated administrator login through the web UI succeeded (302 to dashboard), demonstrating operational end-to-end behavior; API ping returns status ok/version 2.0.2; DB has 138 tables and database_version 2.0.2; daemon runs as user qisutu with successful mail-fetch iteration. Limitations: no real systemd in the container (tini PID 1), so service management was exercised via the systemctl shim/manual start rather than systemd; cosmetic Login.pm 'Odd number of elements in hash assignment' warnings appear but do not affect operation; external IMAP/SMTP/LDAP integrations were not tested as they require operator credentials. These limitations are environmental or out of scope and do not indicate an incomplete or non-operational installation, so the outcome is success.
